verses.text: If you love being corrected, you love learning. Hating correction is just plain foolish.
A good person receives favor from the LORD. The LORD condemns people who cook up wicked plans.
Doing wrong will never give you solid footing. The roots of people who do right won't be shaken.
A wife with character is her husband's crown. A wife who brings disgrace is like rot deep in his bones.
People who do right think about what's fair. The advice of the wicked is loaded with lies.
Wicked people use words to set an ambush for blood. Honest people can talk their way out of danger.
The wicked get knocked down and vanish. The household of people who do right keeps standing.
People get credit for being wise. Someone whose thinking is twisted gets looked down on.
Better to be a nobody who can afford a servant than act important when you can't even afford bread.
People who do right care about their animals' lives. Even what the wicked call kindness turns out cruel.
Work your land and you'll have plenty of bread. Chase fantasies and you show you haven't got sense.
The wicked want the loot other evildoers have. People who do right have roots that thrive.
The wicked get trapped by the wrong things they say. People who do right make it out of trouble.
Good words bring good things back to you. What you do with your hands earns its own reward.
A fool looks at their own road and thinks it's right. A wise person hears people out.
A fool lets you know they're annoyed right away. Someone with good judgment lets an insult pass.
An honest person tells the truth on the stand. A false witness lies.
Some people speak without thinking and cut like a sword. Wise words help people heal.
Truthful words stand forever. A lie only lasts a moment.
People who plan evil carry deceit in their hearts. People who work for peace find joy.
Trouble won't overtake those who do right. The wicked will get their fill of evil.
The LORD can't stand lies. He takes delight in people who stay true to their word.
A sensible person doesn't broadcast everything they know. Fools can't help announcing how foolish they are.
People who work hard end up in charge. Laziness lands people in forced labor.
Anxiety weighs your heart down. A kind word can lift it.
Someone who does right is careful about who they befriend. The road the wicked take leads people off course.
A lazy person won't even cook what they caught. What diligent people have is precious.
There's life on the road of doing right. There's no death on that path.
